exam.title: Managing and Securing Microsoft 365 Endpoints by Using Intune
exam.study_prerequisites: Strong Windows client and Microsoft 365 administration plus practical Microsoft Intune, Entra device identity and Conditional Access, Autopilot, Android/Apple/macOS enrollment, Defender for Endpoint, application packaging, endpoint security, Windows 365, PowerShell, Graph, reporting and troubleshooting experience.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Optimize endpoint operations by using automation, monitoring, and reporting
guide_sections: Section 5 — Alert rules for compliance drift, enrollment failure, and configuration conflict

review.notes: Every July 24, 2026 subobjective is mapped to a device identity, enrollment, targeting, policy, application, access, operating, evidence, failure, or recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight labs, and 39 checks include source-aware alert paths and controlled operational evidence. All 42 URLs are cataloged: 39 reachable, three O'Reilly/Udemy pages access-blocked, and none missing. The September 7 watch maps blueprint-era Intune Suite wording to current Advanced capabilities and bounds Agent 365 as adjacent evidence.

findings.title: Legacy app-grant advice outdated
findings.evidence: Current specific lifecycle notice states read-only behavior and continued enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Use app protection for new policies and a tested replacement migration.
findings.resolution: Use app protection for new policies and a tested replacement migration.

findings.title: Device-preparation operational limits
findings.evidence: Mode, app/script count and enrollment group differ from classic Autopilot.
findings.recommendation: Add provisioning group owner, device-based OOBE and feature-versus-lifecycle distinction.
findings.resolution: Add provisioning group owner, device-based OOBE and feature-versus-lifecycle distinction.

findings.title: Deployment template versus execution
findings.evidence: Preview deployments carry one payload with explicit support limits.
findings.recommendation: Add ring/intent/supersedence boundaries and unique-device target example.
findings.resolution: Add ring/intent/supersedence boundaries and unique-device target example.

findings.title: Cancellation is not recovery
findings.evidence: Completed ring assignments remain after cancel or pause.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit rollback and mutable-payload evidence.
findings.resolution: Add explicit rollback and mutable-payload evidence.

findings.title: Backup and restore policies differ
findings.evidence: Default transition and restore paths are version/identity scoped.
findings.recommendation: Add policy-state worked example and separate restore prerequisites.
findings.resolution: Add policy-state worked example and separate restore prerequisites.

findings.title: Settings protection is not file/profile protection
findings.evidence: Documented scope differs from whole-device and nonpersistent profile recovery.
findings.recommendation: Add file protection and persistent/nonpersistent path qualification.
findings.resolution: Add file protection and persistent/nonpersistent path qualification.

findings.title: Live query requires endpoint communication
findings.evidence: Single-device WNS query is bounded by connectivity and query support.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish failed communication from zero findings.
findings.resolution: Distinguish failed communication from zero findings.

findings.title: Inventory queries have different evidence
findings.evidence: Fleet results depend on collection policy and component row shape.
findings.recommendation: Explain age, coverage and distinct-device counting before assigning results.
findings.resolution: Explain age, coverage and distinct-device counting before assigning results.

findings.title: Eligibility is a conjunction
findings.evidence: Baseline/VBS requirements and fallback affect restart outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Add intersection example and Arm64 compatibility decision.
findings.resolution: Add intersection example and Arm64 compatibility decision.

findings.title: Remediation trigger is specific
findings.evidence: Only detection exit 1 runs the paired fix.
findings.recommendation: Add three-state uncertainty and verification example.
findings.resolution: Add three-state uncertainty and verification example.

findings.title: Custom compliance is separate
findings.evidence: Discovery plus JSON reports compliance; Windows custom script cadence differs.
findings.recommendation: Separate built-in reevaluation, discovery and remediation.
findings.resolution: Separate built-in reevaluation, discovery and remediation.

findings.title: Agent listing superseded by lifecycle page
findings.evidence: Specific removal notice overrides older available-agent overview.
findings.recommendation: Mark Device Offboarding Agent unavailable since June 1.
findings.resolution: Mark Device Offboarding Agent unavailable since June 1.

findings.title: Agent identity needs explicit authorization
findings.evidence: Agentic user needs its own delegated permissions and readiness.
findings.recommendation: Describe one-way transition, preserved history and independent outcome verification.
findings.resolution: Describe one-way transition, preserved history and independent outcome verification.

findings.title: Published entries can be future-dated
findings.evidence: September 28 section was observed on September 27.
findings.recommendation: Label future release entries and schedule rollout recheck.
findings.resolution: Label future release entries and schedule rollout recheck.

findings.title: Unattended support has a narrower matrix
findings.evidence: Physical corporate x64 prerequisites differ from attended Windows 365/AVD support.
findings.recommendation: Clarify targeted permission, agents, power and network requirements.
findings.resolution: Clarify targeted permission, agents, power and network requirements.

findings.title: Faster evaluation does not imply instant exports
findings.evidence: Client-triggered requests and exported reporting are separate.
findings.recommendation: Add 90% reported versus 75% fleet coverage example and setting-specific evidence.
findings.resolution: Add 90% reported versus 75% fleet coverage example and setting-specific evidence.
